# Soundly

> Soundly is an online hearing health marketplace that simplifies finding, comparing, and purchasing hearing aids with free testing, expert reviews, and transparent pricing.

Soundly provides a modern platform for hearing aid discovery and comparison, featuring a free online hearing test, side-by-side product comparisons, expert-tested reviews, and educational content about hearing health. The site serves as a comprehensive resource for both OTC and prescription hearing aid options, helping consumers make informed decisions about their hearing care.

## Core Services

- [Soundly | The New Way to Shop for Hearing Aids Online](https://www.soundly.com): Soundly hearing health marketplace for comparing aids, prices, and care.
- [Online Hearing Test With Fast, Free Results | Soundly](https://www.soundly.com/hearing-test): Free 3-minute online hearing test with instant results and recommendations.
- [Shop](https://www.soundly.com/shop): Compare OTC and prescription hearing aids side-by-side with prices.
